summary: FOC Heat research for the October 19, 2026 FOC window. No current BUY is justified. Chainkata #1 and Absolute Batman: Beyond Ark M #1 merit WATCH status, but the former relies mainly on creator-level precedent and the latter's earlier related issue sales do not prove this follow-up will appreciate. Preserve capital; do not chase variants.
orderingWindow: Comic Previews' Last Call page and PRH's retailer catalog identify Monday, October 19, 2026 as the current FOC date. Comic Previews lists the following candidates with that FOC and release dates. Exact ordering time depends on retailer; confirm the chosen shop's deadline before submitting. Do not assume a universal cutoff hour.

books.title: CHAINKATA #1
books.creators: Daniel Warren Johnson (cover artist; verify full story credits from final solicitation before ordering)
verifiedFacts: Comic Previews lists standard Cover A at $3.99, release November 18, 2026, FOC October 19, 2026.
The listing identifies Image Comics and Daniel Warren Johnson on Cover A.
Current public listing does not establish print run, retailer orders, or a key first appearance.
marketEvidence: PriceCharting shows completed sales for Daniel Warren Johnson's Transformers #1 Cover A first print frequently around $30-$50 in July-August 2026, with other cover editions much lower. These are creator/series-specific historical results, not evidence for Chainkata demand.
No issue-specific completed sales are possible before release; no credible order or print-run figure verified.
books.thesis: Creator-level market history is unusually strong, but that is not enough to justify a FOC BUY. A $3.99 standard copy limits nominal exposure; however, no verified issue-specific demand signal exists. WATCH only; revisit after release and look for completed sales net of fees/shipping.
unknowns: Full verified story creative team and premise from a primary solicitation
Whether Chainkata develops a durable key or collector catalyst

books.title: ABSOLUTE BATMAN: BEYOND ARK M #1
books.creators: Scott Snyder and Frank Tieri (writers); Francesco Francavilla (art and cover); Dustin Nguyen (variant cover)
verifiedFacts: DC's November solicitation lists a 32-page one-shot at $4.99, on sale November 11, 2026; Comic Previews lists FOC October 19, 2026.
The solicitation describes it as a continuation of the Ark M storyline, with Joker surveying his empire of Arks.
A $6.99 card-stock variant is solicited; standard Cover A is the only edition considered here.
marketEvidence: PriceCharting records completed sales for the preceding Absolute Batman: Ark M Special #1 standard first print, including roughly $8.50-$14.42 ungraded sales in late August and September 2026; some later printings sold near $5-$7.
Those sales are for the preceding special, not this new issue. They may reflect its specific story/key status and do not prove the sequel will command a premium.
books.thesis: The strongest evidence among this week's candidates is the related issue's observed standard-copy demand, but extrapolation is risky: the prior issue may have had a distinct catalyst, and follow-up demand can decay quickly. WATCH, not BUY. Do not pay a premium or speculate on the variant.
unknowns: Whether the new issue contains a key first appearance or other durable catalyst
Retailer order volume and print run
Whether the preceding issue's sales translate to this follow-up
Post-release completed sales and sustained demand

methodologyNotes: Completed sales for related issues and creators are context, not proof of demand for a new issue.
